records.context: Lisbon Guild. Rafael checks the available merchandise and selects an item after a 27,000-gold investment.
records.source_meaning: The Guildmaster greets Rafael and asks what he needs.
records.localization_note: The relaxed greeting fits the Guildmaster and lets Rafael choose between buying and selling.

records.speaker: Guildmaster
records.context: Lisbon Guild. Rafael checks the available merchandise and selects an item after a 27,000-gold investment.
records.english: It's supposed to be a twisted horn. Some say it came from a dragon. Word is, you can turn it into medicine that cures any illness.
records.clean_Japanese:
ねじまがったツノなんだそうだ
竜のツノだって言うやつもいる
どんな病にも効く薬になるって
噂もある
records.source_meaning: The Guildmaster repeats rumors about a twisted horn, its possible dragon origin and its use in a cure.
records.localization_note: The three hearsay cues carry the uncertainty. The full claim about the medicine stays together.

records.speaker: Item catalogue
records.context: The Lisbon Guild Buy Items list describes Travels of Marco Polo before Rafael chooses whether to buy.
records.english: Completed in the 13th century, this book tells what Marco Polo saw and heard on his travels in the East.
records.clean_Japanese: １３世紀に完成した書物。マルコ・ポーロが東方へ旅行したときに見聞きしたことをまとめたもの。
records.source_meaning: A book completed in the 13th century that compiles what Marco Polo saw and heard while traveling in the East.
records.localization_note: Book, date, region and first-hand sources are intact. The entry reads as a description beside the item and price.

records.context: The Lisbon Guild Buy Items list describes Twisted Horn Map 2 before Rafael chooses whether to buy.
records.english: One of four pieces of an ancient map.
records.clean_Japanese: 古の地図の断片。四枚で一組の地図。
records.source_meaning: A fragment of an ancient map that forms a set with three other pieces.
